title: Order Samurai Detection Table
description: Declarative source of truth for repo_auditor.py's static regex detections (previously hardcoded as SECRET_PATTERNS/SECURITY_PATTERNS Python literals). Contributing a new detection means adding one entry here plus one fixture in detection_fixtures.json -- no Python change required. See docs/CONTRIBUTING-DETECTIONS.md.

version.description: Bumped whenever the schema shape (not the detection list) changes.

id.description: Stable slug, never reused. Keys the required fixture entry in detection_fixtures.json.

category.description: Drives the description template (see repo_auditor.py's _DESCRIPTION_TEMPLATES) and which finding-category label ships in the report.

pattern.description: A Python re pattern, matched with re.search against each source line. Plain text unless pattern_encoding is set.

pattern_encoding.description: Present only when the pattern's OWN literal source text is itself a valid match for what it detects (e.g. a private-key header regex with no metacharacters) -- committing it in cleartext would make this file itself trip the detection it defines. See docs/CONTRIBUTING-DETECTIONS.md before adding a new base64 entry; it is the exception, not the default.

title.description: Short human-readable finding title. Also the CONFIRMABLE_KINDS lookup key when confirmable_kind is set -- must stay unique.

remediation.description: Actionable, detection-specific guidance -- not a generic category-level template.

confirmable_kind.description: Set only for the Phase 6 mechanically-confirmable subset. Absence means the finding never receives a confirmation tag -- exactly the existing 'omitted means not applicable' idiom, now driven from data instead of a separate hardcoded dict that could silently drift from this table's titles.
